title: A7 Evidence Grounder output
description: The grounded panel stack. A7 is the ONLY minter of numbers in the fleet, and every number it mints travels inside a Value whose source_id resolves in the source registry it was handed. Panels are validated against the shipping contract itself (narrative.schema.json), not a copy of it, so a panel that cannot ship cannot be ingested either. Candidates A7 could not cite are reported in `dropped` rather than rendered (PRD T4).

dropped.description: A6 proposals that no registry source could carry. Naming them is how the run stays honest about what was looked for and not found.

model.description: The identity the agent reports from its own system context.
